posts.materialUpdate: Fresh exact-project broker posts dated 26 September 2026 plus DLD-derived identity and registration verification.
posts.body:
YIGO LUXE — PRE-LAUNCH / EOI
YIGO Development | Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai

Fresh indexed broker posts dated 26 September are promoting early access to a furnished high-rise with studios, 1BR, 1.5BR and 2BR apartments.

Broker and portal indications start from AED 798,000, with 50/50 and post-handover structures circulating. These are NOT confirmed developer terms. A DLD-derived register snapshot identifies the legal developer and a March 2030 filed completion, but an open escrow account was not verified.

Why it matters: an early DSO launch signal before the official price list and escrow confirmation.
Confidence: high on identity/location; medium on the pre-launch package.

https://graf.ae/launches/yigo-luxe-dubai-silicon-oasis/
